findings.highlight: my own emptied lunch plate
findings.evidenceJa: 目の前の、綺麗に平らげたランチプレート
findings.explanation: Haruki is looking at Youko's completely cleared lunch plate as evidence of her forced performance. The translation makes the plate his own, reversing the observed eater and breaking the setup for her condition.
findings.japanese:
目の前の、綺麗に平らげたランチプレートを見ながら、
俺も少しだけ、彼と同じ表情をしてみせる。
findings.todokanai: Looking at my own emptied lunch plate in front of me, I make the same expression as him.

findings.highlight: only had to take out the IV from her hand
findings.evidenceJa: 腕から点滴の管を引き抜いたところだった
findings.explanation: The IV tube had just been pulled from Youko's arm when Haruki arrived. The translation relocates it to her hand and makes removal a remaining task rather than a just-completed action.
findings.japanese:
俺が病院に迎えに行ったとき、
曜子さんはちょうど午前の診察を終え、
腕から点滴の管を引き抜いたところだった。
findings.todokanai: When I went to pick Youko-san up from the hospital, she was just about done with her medical checkup, and only had to take out the IV from her hand.

findings.highlight: just discovered a bottle of morphine
findings.evidenceJa: 末期ガンの患者がとうとうモルヒネに手を出した感じ
findings.explanation: Youko likens herself to a terminal patient who has finally resorted to morphine: a deliberate last-resort act in a dependency metaphor. Merely discovering a bottle removes that choice and the sense of crossing a threshold.
findings.japanese:
「正直で、面白くて、そして危険なコね。
…ちょっと自分のしたことにビビったかも。
末期ガンの患者がとうとうモルヒネに手を出した感じ」
findings.todokanai: "You're an honest, funny and dangerous child… I might even feel a bit scared of what I just did. I feel like a patient with terminal cancer who just discovered a bottle of morphine."

findings.highlight: you have courage
findings.evidenceJa: あなたは勇気がありすぎる
findings.explanation: Youko says Haruki has too much courage, continuing her warning that his persistence is dangerous. The translation turns excessive courage into unqualified praise.
findings.japanese:
「わたしには全然そうは思えない。
だって、あなたは勇気がありすぎる」
findings.todokanai: "I don't think so at all. After all, you have courage."

findings.highlight: If you've hesitated many times before reaching the top of the cliff. If you've been pushed forward
findings.evidenceJa: 何度も逡巡して呼び出した崖の上だからこそ。葛藤に葛藤を重ねて押した背中だからこそ
findings.explanation: The omitted subject is Youko: she hesitated repeatedly before calling Haruki to the cliff, then pushed his back only after conflict upon conflict. The translation makes Haruki reach the top and be pushed there, reversing both agency and action.
findings.japanese:
何度も逡巡して呼び出した崖の上だからこそ。
葛藤に葛藤を重ねて押した背中だからこそ。
findings.todokanai: If you've hesitated many times before reaching the top of the cliff. If you've been pushed forward toward the top through conflict after conflict…

findings.highlight: it's that very trouble that reaches out its hand toward you
findings.evidenceJa: 崖下に落ちていく俺に手を差し伸べようとする葛藤は、押したときの何倍も抱えているに違いない
findings.explanation: Haruki infers that Youko must now feel many times more conflict trying to reach toward the falling man than she felt when pushing him. The translation turns abstract 'trouble' into the acting hand and loses Youko, the comparison, and the magnitude of her conflict.
findings.japanese:
崖下に落ちていく俺に手を差し伸べようとする葛藤は、
押したときの何倍も抱えているに違いない。
findings.todokanai: Then it's that very trouble that reaches out its hand toward you when you fall off, with much more strength than it had when it pushed you forward.

findings.highlight: as if we're both guilty parties in some war crime
findings.evidenceJa: 一緒に悪事を働いた戦友にして戦犯同士のような
findings.explanation: Their solidarity is deliberately double-edged: comrades-in-arms who committed the wrongdoing together and fellow war criminals. The translation retains only shared guilt and drops the comradely half of the bond.
findings.japanese:
俺たちには、
一緒に悪事を働いた戦友にして戦犯同士のような、
奇妙な連帯感が生まれていた。
findings.todokanai: A weird feeling of solidarity grows between us, as if we're both guilty parties in some war crime.

findings.highlight: I'm full.
findings.evidenceJa: ごちそうさま
findings.explanation: Youko ends the meal with the conventional ごちそうさま, not a claim that she is satiated. This matters because more than half remains and the scene has established that nausea, not fullness, stopped her.
findings.japanese:
「…もういい。
ごちそうさま」
findings.todokanai: "…That's enough. I'm full."

findings.highlight: No one ever trusts me.
findings.evidenceJa: 信用ないんだな、あたし
findings.explanation: Kazusa says that she has no credibility with Haruki in this exchange. The translation turns that relational complaint into an absolute claim that nobody ever trusts her.
findings.japanese: 「信用ないんだな、あたし」
findings.todokanai: "No one ever trusts me."

findings.highlight: thanks to you not worrying about it
findings.evidenceJa: 特別に心配しなかったせいでお前は
findings.explanation: Haruki blames himself: because he did not worry especially last time, Kazusa ended up harmed. The translation blames Kazusa for not worrying, reversing the subject of his guilt.
findings.japanese: けどあの時、特別に心配しなかったせいでお前は…
findings.todokanai: But thanks to you not worrying about it back then, the result was…

findings.highlight: yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 一昨日
findings.explanation: Kazusa would not let Haruki go the day before yesterday, not yesterday. The one-day shift alters the already tightly specified sequence around her return and recovery.
findings.japanese:
一昨日は離してくれなかったのに、
今日はあまりにも素っ気なく突き放そうとする。
findings.todokanai: She wouldn't let go of me yesterday, yet today she's being uncomfortably blunt about throwing me out.

findings.highlight: Having you around against my will
findings.evidenceJa: 嫌々側にいられても迷惑なだけだ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says it is no help if Haruki stays beside her unwillingly; the reluctance she imagines is his. The translation makes his presence violate her will, reversing whose unwillingness motivates the complaint.
findings.japanese:
「それが余計なお世話だって言うんだ。
こっちだって、嫌々側にいられても迷惑なだけだ。
さっさと雪菜のもとに帰れよ！」
findings.todokanai: "I'm telling you that I don't want that. Having you around against my will is a nuisance for me too. Go to where Setsuna is already!"

findings.highlight: You were talking to Setsuna
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜と、繋がってたんだろ
findings.explanation: Kazusa accuses Haruki of remaining connected to Setsuna before her eyes, even through unanswered emails. 'Talking to Setsuna' makes the contact sound reciprocal and conversational when the next lines stress that no replies came.
findings.japanese:
「いつもいつも、ここで打ってただろ？
雪菜と、繋がってたんだろ？
…あたしの、目の前で」
findings.todokanai: "You were typing them all the time here, weren't you? You were talking to Setsuna… right in front of me."

findings.highlight: my only friend in the whole world
findings.evidenceJa: 世界で一人きりの、あたしの肉親
findings.explanation: Kazusa calls Youko her only blood relative in the world. The translation replaces this unique family bond with friendship, obscuring why being kept from her mother is intolerable.
findings.japanese:
「どうして駄目なんだよ…
あの人は、世界で一人きりの、あたしの肉親なんだぞ？」
findings.todokanai: "Why can't I…? She's my only friend in the whole world, you know?"

findings.highlight: these upcoming days
findings.evidenceJa: ここ数日ものすごく忙しい
findings.explanation: Haruki says Youko has been extremely busy over the past or recent few days. The translation shifts the workload into the future, weakening his improvised explanation for her present absence.
findings.japanese:
「曜子さん、ここ数日ものすごく忙しいんだよ！
だからさ、今だけは手を患わせたりするなよ」
findings.todokanai: "Youko-san is really busy these upcoming days! That's why you shouldn't cause her trouble."

findings.highlight: holding Youko-san down
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が曜子さんを抑え込んでる。彼女の反対を押し切って
findings.explanation: Haruki means that he is overruling or restraining Youko's opposition, as the next sentence explicitly clarifies. 'Holding Youko-san down' physicalizes the control and can falsely suggest bodily force.
findings.japanese:
本当は、俺が曜子さんを抑え込んでる。
彼女の反対を押し切って、かずさの側にいる。
findings.todokanai: The truth is, I'm the one holding Youko-san down. I'm by Kazusa's side despite her objections.

findings.highlight: tricked her with lukewarm crocodile tears
findings.evidenceJa: 生温い憂いと猫なで声で欺き続ける
findings.explanation: Haruki condemns himself for deceiving Setsuna with lukewarm concern or melancholy and a coaxing voice. The translation invents crocodile tears, drops the vocal tactic, and changes how his false tenderness operates.
findings.japanese:
生温い憂いと猫なで声で欺き続ける悪魔の俺に、
また騙され、裏切られているというのに…
findings.todokanai: Even when she was being deceived and betrayed again, by the devil who tricked her with lukewarm crocodile tears.

findings.highlight: work at home to do
findings.evidenceJa: 特命業務で外回りばかり
findings.explanation: Haruki says special assignments have kept him continually out making rounds or field visits. The translation gives him work at home, the opposite location and working pattern.
findings.japanese:
「そうだな…まぁ、
色々と特命業務で外回りばかり…
あ、全部食うなよ？　半分だけだからな？」
findings.todokanai: "I am… Well, I've had tons of special assignments and work at home to do… Ah, don't eat it all. Only half of it, okay?"

findings.highlight: gave Takahiro any hush money
findings.evidenceJa: 孝宏に口止めしてなかったろ
findings.explanation: Takeya says Haruki did not tell Takahiro to keep quiet, then jokes that asking would have been futile. The translation invents a bribe and turns a failed secrecy instruction into payment.
findings.japanese:
「なんてな～。
お前、孝宏に口止めしてなかったろ？
…って、止めたところで無駄なんだけどな」
findings.todokanai: "Just kidding. You never gave Takahiro any hush money… Not that it would stop him from spilling the beans."

findings.highlight: she has done the right thing
findings.evidenceJa: それどころか、正しいことだ
findings.explanation: Haruki says the friends' celebration and the engagement they believe in are not wrong but right. The translation assigns a completed righteous act to Setsuna, changing the subject and action of his self-persuasion.
findings.japanese: それどころか、正しいことだ。
findings.todokanai: Not only that, she has done the right thing.

findings.highlight: desperately running away from me
findings.evidenceJa: 必死で掛け出そうとしていたその背中
findings.explanation: Kazusa is desperately trying or preparing to break into a run when Haruki's call makes her back twitch. The translation makes her already running away, collapsing the hesitation and start of flight.
findings.japanese:
必死で掛け出そうとしていたその背中が、
少しだけ決心が揺るいだように、びくっと震えた。
findings.todokanai: The back of the person desperately running away from me starts to tremble, as if there is a crack in her determination.

findings.highlight: my only two friends in the world
findings.evidenceJa: 世界で二人だけの親友
findings.explanation: Kazusa calls Haruki and Setsuna her only two best friends in the world. The translation downgrades 親友 to ordinary friends at the climax of her forced congratulations.
findings.japanese:
「世界で二人だけの親友が、一緒になってさぁ…
最初から、ずっと決まってたことが
とうとう本当に決まっちゃってさぁ…っ」
findings.todokanai: "To see my only two friends in the world get together… To see the thing that was bound to happen from the start finally happen…!"
